The `three*.mjs` files load only for the 3D battlefield (src/render3d/, the default view); the classic 2D view never loads them. `stats.min.js` and `tweakpane.min.mjs` load only with `?debug`. `mocha.*` and `chai.mjs` load only in `tests/index.html`. `duel-net.js`, `qrcode.min.js` and `jsqr.min.js` load only when two phones pair (src/net/link.js); the game uses `Duel.Peer`, `Duel.Qr` and `Duel.Diag` from it and never calls `Duel.start`.

**Build-time tools, not shipped:** the voice lines in `assets/sound/v/` were spoken by Kokoro v1.0 (`kokoro-onnx` 0.4+, model `kokoro-v1.0.onnx` and `voices-v1.0.bin` from github.com/thewh1teagle/kokoro-onnx, Apache-2.0) and processed by `tools/audio`; the effects in `assets/sound/s/` are synthesised there with numpy/scipy. Only the rendered MP3s and `sounds.json` are part of the game.
